headline: As of 2026-10-31: 53,391,897 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 48 of 50 states, D+8.8 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 53,391,897 early/mail ballots cast so far across 48 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+8.8 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Texas (7,713,754), California (5,545,910), Florida (4,992,972).
